Market today: The market mood is cautious for tech/chips. Surging US Treasury yields, hitting a 19-year high, are the real driver, making growth stocks less attractive. AI chip stocks are already pulling back.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -49.27% with a 'SELL' status; its leveraged nature and decay are amplified by margin. SPAL, also leveraged, is new but down -36.54%. SMH is on 'TRIM' status, down -10.47% and nearing its stop. Margin amplifies all these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields for any further increases. Also, monitor the chip sector for continued weakness.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and protect capital, especially with leveraged positions facing macro headwinds.
plays: Consider reducing SOXL exposure given the 'SELL' status and significant -49.27% loss; leveraged ETFs decay and margin amplifies drops.
Trim SMH as indicated by 'TRIM' status; respect the 540 stop if weakness continues in chip names.
Review SPAL, a new leveraged position down -36.54%; its volatility and decay are amplified by margin.
